content:
Melissa H: Quick sync — planning the webinar launch posts + inbound routing. Need a short SEO checklist we can run before publish: keywords, JSON-LD schema, internal link sweep, and redirects. Im aiming for the blog + landing to go live next week.

Jon A: Sounds good. Can we lock 3 primary keywords and a small set of supporting terms? Also want to make sure canonical and hreflang (if needed) are set.

Melissa H: Primary targets: "LLM inference platform", "low-latency LLM serving", "dedicated inference clusters". Supporting list: inference orchestration, KV cache, quantization profiles, model rollouts, inference cost optimization, fallback routing.

Tara L: For schema, recommend WebPage + Event + FAQ. I can add a minimal JSON-LD block and iterate with copy. Example to drop into the head: 
```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Event\",\"name\":\"Redwood Inference: Serving LLMs in Prod (Webinar)\",\"startDate\":\"2024-06-10T16:00:00Z\",\"organizer\":{\"@type\":\"Organization\",\"name\":\"Redwood Inference\"},\"url\":\"https://redwood.inference/webinar/serving-llms\"}</script>
```
I will follow up with FAQ entries pulled from the webinar script.

Devon P: For redirects — map legacy doc paths to the new landing. Quick CSV sample Ill use for the sweep: 
```
source,target,code
/old-launch,/webinar/serving-llms,301
/docs/inference,/webinar/serving-llms,301
/blog/2023/llm-inference,/webinar/serving-llms,301
```
I'll run the sweep the night after publish.

Jon A: Internal linking plan: PRs to add CTAs from product pages (/docs/runtime, /product/features) to the landing page. Suggested anchor texts: "Low-latency serving", "Dedicated capacity", "Reduce inference cost". Keep global nav untouched. I'll open the PRs.

Melissa H: Inbound lead routing: marketing will send GCLID/UTM + webinar_id to the CRM. Routing rule: company_size > 50 -> SDR queue; else -> nurture. Will add a field for "interested_in" for product SKU. @Devon can you confirm webhook param names and acceptable payload?

Devon P: Confirmed. Webhook will include: email, first_name, last_name, company, company_size (number), utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, webinar_id. Example payload param: "company_size": 42. Will include a 200 OK on success.

Tara L: Messaging iteration — two hero variants to A/B test on the signup modal:
A) "Ship LLM features with predictable latency"
B) "Cut inference cost while keeping your SLAs"
We'll run 50/50 for the first 1k impressions and evaluate CTR and conversion.

Jon A: Timeline proposal: blog draft ready by Fri (1712343600), landing live Mon (1712429999), redirect sweep Mon night. Owners: @Tara for schema & copy, @Devon for redirects & webhooks, @Jon for internal links, @Melissa PM.

Melissa H: @all I'll create a Trello card and attach the draft + keyword doc. Any blockers?

Jon A: None from Eng. :thumbsup:

SEO-bot: New task created — MARKETING-4122 "webinar landing SEO + redirects" (https://trello.company/board/card/ MARKETING-4122)

Melissa H: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the draft link in here when it's up.
